public.title: 1 · Public (anonymous)
public.cond: Ladder base. Reads + session registration. Auth walls → /signin. Guests via /l/:code see the SAME session page (scoped) — no special guest views. FOOTER (every page, all roles): beta notice + "GDPR concerns → support@uadebate.com".

participant.title: 2 · Participant (registered speaker)
participant.cond: All public pages + own signup on the session page (cancel, my room row tinted). Session-scoped identity, not a club role: member or guest — same page.

judge.title: 2 · Judge (chairs a room)
judge.cond: All public + participant pages + the room panel: draw, set/publish motion, fill ballot. Powers come from the CHAIR of a room; judge before rooms exist = spectator.

member.title: 3 · Member
member.cond: All public pages + participant/judge by registering + member tree: cabinet, members, sessions archive, MY PAGE (global stats). Member of several clubs — fine.

owner.title: 4 · Owner (club head)
owner.cond: All member pages (and every room's judge powers) + the owner tree. FULL CONTROL: set/publish motions, fill/edit/confirm ballots on EVERY room — editing a confirmed ballot is one "edit ballot" action (lock handling is internal, never a page verb). Lifecycle: Start session → Reopen registration | Finish session.

admin.title: 5 · Admin (platform)
admin.cond: Every club's owner tree + all below + /admin: club creation, user ops. is_admin, 404 for everyone else.

phoenix-api.title: 6 · Phoenix API — /api/v1 (cab)
phoenix-api.cond: Every page verb above is one of these REST calls — same ClubScope ladder enforces role coverage. Session cookie today; keyed public API = pillar 3. Green = the engine call behind the write.

engine-api.title: 7 · Engine API — node :3100 (internal only)
engine-api.cond: Everything cab persists lives here; only cab calls it. Auth: HS256 JWT {id, isAdmin} minted per request by cab. Guards: admin · org = owner/organiser · chair = room judge (falls through to org). Never public.
